items.title: Water Line
items.tone: Mas alone at 2 a.m., calm and sure of himself: felt upright, a trio in two, the chip only on the nudge
items.where: Mas's theme. First heard in Ep1 sc 18 (the dark room, 10:13); then every episode's rooms, nights and V.O.; in Act Four its felt carries 26A (v4 S2) and his side at 2 a.m. (v4 S5)
items.listen: Calm, not sad: would you know this tune again after two bars?

moments.what: the felt alone: the flat line and the nudge; the settle held back
the trio comes in (upright in two, brushes) under statement 1
V.O. window: felt alone, nothing moves
statement 2: the violas now join the cellos' guide tones (fix 1)
the second V.O. window

items.title: Beeper, 1993 / Sample-Chip, 2008
items.tone: His past as the machine heard it: a 1-bit beeper in 1993, then a 16-bit memory of 2008
items.where: The flashbacks. Ep1 sc 3-4 (F1.1, 1993, 0:30); its 1-bit flat line returns inside MM-08 and MM-11
items.listen: A memory, or a video game? Nothing may sound Nintendo

moments.what: 1993: NESNEJ's Upsell on the beeper (two voices, on or off, no dynamics)
the close lands
THE EMPTY SLOT (the SFX register clunks here, with no bell)
2008: the trio through the 16-bit sample-chip, pushed half a beat early
young Mas plays his line, with the nudge twice

items.title: The More You Buy
items.tone: A sales pitch that climbs a step every bar and always closes: double-time swing, vibes and a straight mute over a walking bass
items.where: Nesnej, deals, the upsell. Ep1 sc 17 (the rooftop, 9:33), into the register's KA-CHING
items.listen: Does the sale close on the empty downbeat, or does it sound like a dropout?

moments.what: A': the walking bass lands on F (the downbeat that read as an A before fix 1)
the close: an open fifth, bari and trombone stab
THE KA-CHING SLOT: every stem rests the downbeat (the SFX bell owns it)
the tag stalls on C7(#9b13)
the late slot, then nothing

items.title: Renamed It. / The Fountain Pen
items.tone: The state occasion, played straight and one size too big; the joke is the rename, under a held note
items.where: Power. NEDIB's Fountain Pen in Ep1 sc 13 (the White House, 5:54); RUMPT's march and the Rename from Ep2
items.listen: Is the Rename deadpan, or cute?

moments.what: WHO?: RUMPT's march
the missing downbeat: a silent beat where the fanfare should land
the band waits politely; only the pickup plays
SUPER: the full march, the chip on the top line
THE RENAME: E-flat slips to B under the held top note (the label gun lands)
renamed again, to G
the button

items.title: How to Fire a CEO Who Owns Nothing.
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: THE PLAN: a small, precise, cheerful drafting machine (chip music box, harp, pizzicato, dead straight) that explains everything and then breaks
items.where: Ep1 sc 24-25, Act Four's opening (12:31 on the v3 lock; v4 S1). PLAN-SHORT and PLAN-MICRO serve every later episode's THE PLAN
items.listen: Does the break read as the plan failing, or as a playback fault?

moments.what: PLAN: harp eighths draw the path, the chip music box on top (the harp retuned in fix 1)
three ticks, one per step of the plan
the line stops at step four
one held chord, pp, under "Step four." / "Good question."
THE BREAK: the last two notes stick in a loop
the tape-stop
it reaches zero on the JOIN click

items.title: The Falling Tile
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: A trap closing without a tune: F pedal, low grand clusters a semitone apart, a pitched sub-thud, a chip tick; then the click takes every sound away
items.where: Ep1 sc 26: the call, up to the Cancel click and the drop-out (12:52 on the v3 lock; v4 S1, second half)
items.listen: Does the stop on the click land as a blow, or as a glitch? (the top audition item)

moments.what: LEVERAGE low: the grand clusters, now 9 dB up (fix 1)
Neleh's clockwork pizzicato
the 1-bit flat line: 1993, on the call
the clusters move up a semitone
Step Four on muted horns: three steps, level, no riser
THE CLICK: a hard stop into digital silence; the missing fourth step is the silence

items.title: The Board's Side / What They Didn't Know
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: The other side, played straight and with dignity: no felt, no chip, no swing. Then the card
items.where: Ep1 sc 27-28, the board's pass and the card WHAT THEY DIDN'T KNOW (13:18-14:33 on the v3 lock; v4 S3-S4)

moments.what: 11:53 PM: Tasya's floor, one held step on Rhodes and low strings
dry for Tasya's post
"Step four?": the board's chord with its blank
WHAT THEY DIDN'T KNOW: the REVERSAL, C to F up the octave, no third
one felt F4: his room comes back first

items.title: His Version
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: His flattering account: his own tune in D-flat major on the same piano, with everything human removed
items.where: The D5 device ([MAS'S VERSION]). Draft 3.2 cut D5 from Ep1, so it debuts in Ep2 or Ep3; Ep12 plays it uncut. (Its place here is the old sc 29 position.)
items.listen: Parody by polish, or a sincere ad? Compare it with item 1: the same tune?

moments.what: pass 3: too clean, too even, too still; no chip, no swing
pass 4, a shade more confident
CUT mid-note, tails and all

items.title: His Side / 745 (album edit)
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: His version of the five days: the company falls into his lap as a swung avalanche that stops dead on the one man who will not move
items.where: Ep1 sc 29b, the avalanche (15:12-15:30 on the v3 lock; v4 S6), with the episode's one full band. This excerpt is the album edit's new second chorus, which the picture does not have
items.listen: Chorus 2 is new writing: does it add momentum, or just repeat?

moments.what: chorus 2: the board presses (Step Four, the blank crushed)
Step Four crushed again: brass hits
the Water Line twice in the violins, in its own time, over the swung Build
THE FULL BAND on C7(#9b13): three bars, level, no ramp
THE CARD: everything stops dead

items.title: The Return (album edit): a, the Door (STRAIGHT violin)
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: The one sad violin of the season: the Door on a solo violin, senza vibrato, nothing under it
items.where: Ep1 sc 30a, under Alyi's regret post only (15:32 on the v3 lock; v4 S7, where it decays on the first heart instead of stopping dead)
items.listen: Does it avoid "the world's smallest violin"?

moments.what: the Door, plain
again, under the regret post
stopped dead on the first heart

items.title: The Return (album edit): d-e, the Build, the sign, "okay."
items.act: II · Ep1 Act Four, in picture order
items.tone: The other side's sounds hand him back his company: the win played straight and one size too big, then undercut; his felt returns last
items.where: Ep1 sc 30d-e: Gerg is back, the lobby sign, "okay." (16:03-16:23 on the v3 lock; v4 S7-S8)
items.listen: Is the felt the right last word, or one note too many?

moments.what: the Build restarts over the stamp's C pedal (Gerg is back)
the sand's held beat
THE ONE STAB, on the lobby sign; two bars at full
the band cuts to one chip note (the box of spare 0 plates)
the 1-bit flat line
the rest: the bonk and "okay."
his felt: C4 to F4, an open fifth, ringing out

items.title: Outside Intended Scope
items.tone: The machine learning the show's tune, politely
items.where: Ep1's GLYPH hits (the Orb's scan, Q*); the L1-L4 beds as the dread curve rises, L4 from Ep9
items.listen: Thrilling, or just loud? Dread, or a screensaver?

moments.what: L4, the runaway: the tokens play the knee's first seven notes, then keep climbing past the end
under it, a line climbs an octave every two bars, cello to violins
one glass D-flat 6 over a sub swell (the sub now 9 dB lower, fix 1)
cut dead
